entries.title: Inherited terminal acceptance referred to unrelated .NET apps
entries.evidence: .claude/skills/process-plan/SKILL.md before this migration required a clean Windows machine without the .NET SDK for an Isotone-era release domain.
entries.proposal: Keep terminal acceptance tied to RasterFold release targets and validate both family skill copies after future ports.

entries.title: Stop requests must retain identity independently of time and later pause commands
entries.evidence: build/wsl-audit/runner-hardening-before.log records reproduced stop/pause overwrite and clock-rollback failures; .codex/tests/test_runner.py now exercises both, plus resume and native-trust interleavings.
entries.proposal: Retain one immutable file per native event, acknowledge request ids, and make unhandled stops dominate pause. Keep the interruption regressions in the gate suite.

entries.title: Campaign edits must remain repairable at a proven stopped boundary
entries.evidence: On 2026-09-30 campaign.py imported AdmissionBusy before admission.py defined it; PreToolUse denied all edit tools. The operator supplied the missing class. test_broken_controller_allows_only_proven_idle_maintenance reproduces the boundary.
entries.proposal: Check ownership through the small admission module before importing campaign code. Permit ordinary maintenance only with proven idle ownership; preserve active/malformed ownership refusal. Publish dependencies before their imports.

entries.title: Campaign discovery ids must match the canonical Origin parser
entries.evidence: build/wsl-audit/origin-regression-before.log records two regression tests with three failures: full UUID run ids from campaign.py and two skills were rejected by scripts/todo-graph.py section_origins.
entries.proposal: Use twelve lowercase hex digits for canonical run provenance, retain independent full UUID generations, and test actual skill commands against the canonical parser.
